analysis.title: GS US Equity Outlook SPX to 8700
key_insights: Goldman Sachs forecasts the S&P 500 will rise 17% to 8,700 by year-end 2027, described as positive but moderating returns versus a 21% annualized return over the past four years.
EPS growth is expected to slow from roughly 30% in 2026 to 18% in 2027.
Key drivers of the forecast are earnings, a solid economy and continued AI investment.
The S&P 500 forward P/E has declined 19% in 2026 and now sits near its 10-year average. GS expects rates and AI uncertainty to keep the P/E near 18x.

Themes highlighted: AI Productivity Candidates (Exhibit 50), Buyback Aristocrats (Exhibit 51), Energy Infrastructure, Transport, Healthcare (biopharma, managed care) and selected Staples (beauty, energy drinks, nicotine).
